source.name: cert-machine audit of openai/math
source.method: Every Comparator challenge re-run on Linux with nanoda switched on, decided by a preregistered rule; every family's challenge statements read against OpenAI's headline, clause by clause. Decider: Comparator (leanprover/comparator d03acab1 = tag v4.34.0, built with the release's toolchain v4.34.1), lean4export 076e8e57, landrun 811cfff5, nanoda_lib 3a240721 — on GitHub's Linux runners (.github/workflows/openai-math-kernel.yml), one j

fields.replay: Per challenge: the audit's Comparator re-run with both kernels, and for files with definition holes whether the displayed statement is proved.
fields.scope_reading: Per family: whether the challenge statements state OpenAI's headline, with the gap and whether OpenAI's Lean note declares it.
fields.finite_checks: Per family: finite parts of its papers decided by exact code written independently from each paper (lane F), with the verdict and what was decided.

adopted.what: Its re-run verdict for each of the 416 challenges, with the held-definition checks for the ten files with definition holes
adopted.where: the Independent replay line on statement pages

adopted.what: Its reading of each of the 242 families against OpenAI's headline, with the gap and whether OpenAI's note declares it
adopted.where: the readings of the scope on family pages

adopted.what: Telling apart a gap OpenAI's note declares from one it does not
Its exact decisions of the finite parts of 66 papers' arguments, including those whose objects were never published
adopted.where: family pages, under finite parts checked by exact computation
